name: American Sign Language
grammar_structure: Topic-Comment and Subject-Verb-Object (SVO) with Non-Manual Signals
alphabet_description: ASL uses a primarily one-handed fingerspelling alphabet originating from the French manual alphabet. Each of the 26 letters is produced with the dominant hand.

alphabet.description: Closed fist with thumb resting alongside the index finger.
Four fingers upright and together, thumb folded across palm.
alphabet.tip: Flat palm with thumb tucked across

alphabet.description: Fingers and thumb curved to form an open C shape.
Index finger points straight up; middle, ring, pinky touch thumb tip to form circle.
Fingers curled tightly with tips resting on thumb tucked below.
Index finger and thumb touch to form circle; middle, ring, pinky fan out upright.
Index finger and thumb extended horizontally parallel to each other; others curled.
Index and middle fingers extended together horizontally; thumb folded over ring/pinky.
Pinky finger extended upright; thumb holds remaining three fingers into palm.
Pinky finger extended upright, then traces letter J curve downward and scoops up.
Index finger points up, middle finger angles forward, thumb rests between them at base.
alphabet.tip: V shape with thumb wedged between

alphabet.description: Thumb and index finger extended at right angle forming crisp L; other fingers curled.
Thumb tucked under three fingers (index, middle, ring); pinky curled beside.
Thumb tucked under two fingers (index, middle); ring and pinky curled.
All fingertips touch thumb tip forming a circular O shape.
Similar to K handshape but pointed downward with middle finger pointing down and index forward.
Similar to G handshape (thumb and index parallel) but pointing downward.
Index and middle fingers crossed over each other; thumb holds ring and pinky.
Tight fist with thumb wrapped across the front of all curled fingers.
Thumb tucked between index and middle finger inside fist.
Index and middle fingers extended straight up and pressed tightly together.
Index and middle fingers extended straight up and spread apart in V shape.
Index, middle, and ring fingers extended and spread apart in W shape.
Index finger bent into a hook shape; other fingers curled into palm with thumb resting.
Thumb and pinky extended widely outward; three middle fingers folded tightly into palm.
Index finger extended, drawing zigzag letter Z in the air in front of signer.

vocabulary.label: HELLO
vocabulary.description: Dominant open hand with thumb tucked touches temple and moves forward/outward like a salute.

vocabulary.label: THANK_YOU
vocabulary.description: Fingertips of flat dominant hand touch chin/lips and arc outward toward the conversational partner.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: palm facing signer at chin, then tilting forward

vocabulary.label: PLEASE
vocabulary.description: Flat dominant hand rubs in a clockwise circle over the center of the chest.

vocabulary.label: HELP
vocabulary.description: Closed dominant fist with thumb extended upward rests on flat upward palm of non-dominant hand; both lift together.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: non-dominant palm up, dominant fist upright

vocabulary.label: YES
vocabulary.description: Fist (S-handshape) tilts forward and back at wrist, nodding like a head.

vocabulary.label: NO
vocabulary.description: Index and middle fingers snap down onto the thumb tip like a closing beak.

vocabulary.label: WANT
vocabulary.description: Both open hands with palms up curve into claw shape while pulling back toward body.

vocabulary.label: NEED
vocabulary.description: X-handshape (crooked index finger) bends downward firmly from the wrist repeatedly.

numbers.description: Index finger extended upright, palm facing forward.
Index and middle fingers extended in V shape.
Thumb, index, and middle fingers extended (classic ASL 3).
Four fingers extended upright, thumb folded across palm.
All five fingers spread widely open.
Thumb touches pinky fingernail tip; index, middle, ring extended.
Thumb touches ring fingernail tip; index, middle, pinky extended.
Thumb touches middle fingernail tip; index, ring, pinky extended.
Thumb touches index fingernail tip (F-shape); middle, ring, pinky extended.
Fist with thumb upright wagging/shaking side-to-side.
